about: Locator.X High-Potential Belts: US ZIP submarkets ranked on what they pay now rather than what they have appreciated, from public home-value and rent index series (ZHVI value + ZORI rent, 61 monthly points, 2021-07-31 → 2026-07-31). `coverage` states what is measured BEFORE anything derived from it: twelve states carry both series and thirty-nine are absent entirely — absent means not measured, never scored low. `method` carries the open weights, the data floor and the per-metro cap. Index values are not prices and gross yield is rent before every operating cost — a screening ratio, never a return. This ranks SUBMARKETS: a ZIP scoring well still has to survive the seven LOCATOR gates on the parcel itself.
extracted: Extracted 2026-09-11 from the published High-Potential Belts analysis (https://claude.ai/code/artifact/5dc4d95d-84e2-46b0-916f-60e928a3bd76). Re-extract rather than edit.

method.why_not_metro: only 31 metros carry both a value and a rent series; 100 regions is not available at metro grain
method.scoring: each component is percentile-ranked across candidates, then weighted over ONLY the components a ZIP can answer; missing components are counted and reported, never imputed
